summary: Iteration 9 delta tested end-to-end. (1) Backend POST /api/market/listings/{id}/track: 6/6 pytest cases pass — contact/share/view increment their respective counters and persist (verified via GET /api/market/listings), invalid kind 'spam' returns 422, missing kind returns 422, nonexistent listing_id returns 200 with {ok:false,kind:...} preserving fire-and-forget semantics. (2) Frontend Market page: registered a fresh user via API, POSTed a Tomato/Maharashtra listing with contact '+919876543210', navigated to /market, clicked data-testid='listing-contact-button' (preventDefault applied to skip new-tab) and data-testid='listing-share-button' — GET /api/market/listings then reported contact_count=1 and share_count=1 for that listing, and data-testid='listing-engagement' chip rendered. (3) LangContext auto-detect: fresh browser contexts with navigator.language(s) overridden via addInitScript → hi-IN,hi stored 'hi' and header shows 'एग्रीस्कैन'; mr-IN,mr stored 'mr' (logo mr text present but uses ZWJ codepoint अ\u200dॅग्रीस्कॅन in i18n.js — matches functionally); ta-IN,ta stored 'ta'; fr-FR,fr (unsupported) fell back to 'en' with 'AgriScan' logo; and with localStorage 'agriscan_lang'='en' preset the hi-IN header did NOT override it (stored='en'). (4) Regression tour of /, /dashboard, /advisor, /market, /profile produced 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py track_listing: consider using $setOnInsert with upsert=False (current impl already does not upsert — OK). Ok.
Market.jsx trackListing: optimistic-update increments locally even when the backend responds ok:false (stale id). Minor — fine for fire-and-forget UX.
i18n.js mr appName uses zero-width joiner (U+200D) between अ and ॅ; harmless but worth normalizing so tests can match the plain 'अॅग्रीस्कॅन' string.
test_credentials: Ephemeral TEST_ users registered via /api/auth/register during tests.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 (POST /api/market/listings/{id}/track + LangContext navigator-based auto-detect + Market engagement chip) fully verified. To retest lang detection, use browser.new_context() + add_init_script overriding navigator.language and navigator.languages BEFORE goto; setExtraHTTPHeaders alone does NOT change navigator.language and will make the test appear to fail.
